entities.name: Andrew Gordon Magrath
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrew Gordon Magrath was an American politician and jurist who served as the last governor of South Carolina under the Confederate States of America, a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the District of South Carolina and a Confederate District Judge for the District of South Carolina.
